<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex040012026-09-0409-58-07" status="unreviewed">lo ka las 'das pa'i laM gyi rgyu tshogs yin pas ma nas spangs pa yin pa'o ||
            de lta ma yin na sgo yang gis ma spangs pa'i sa bya gang zhig <lb edRef="inst:4749" n="88b6"/> sangs rgyas
            kyi sang po' bas rgyas kyi sa'i sang bya zhes pa yang yod pas yan bya <expan>thams cad</expan> mthong las
            rnaM pa la du ma 'dus par 'gyur zhing | sangs rgyas stobs par 'gyur ba'i nyes pa 'ang
            pang bar mi nus so zhes byang chub <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3864">skyabs</rs> <expan>gsungs so</expan> ||</seg></TEI>
